name: Rankifly AI Content Optimizer
author: Ermald Billa

sections.description:
Rankifly AI Content Optimizer brings the power of OpenAI directly into your WordPress editor.
Write better content, rank higher and save hours of manual SEO work — all from the post editing screen.

The plugin works with a BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) model: you connect your own OpenAI API key
(GPT-4.1-mini or any compatible model), so your content never passes through third-party servers.
Full privacy, full control.

Main Features

Real-time SEO Analysis
Analyzes your content against your focus keyword and returns an SEO score (0–100) with
specific, actionable suggestions on keyword density, structure and formatting.

Readability Score
Detects long sentences, passive voice and poorly structured paragraphs — and tells you exactly
what to fix to make your content clearer and easier to rank.

Automatic FAQ Generation with Schema Markup
Generates 3 contextual FAQs from your content, inspired by Google’s “People Also Ask”.
FAQs are saved per post and automatically injected as Schema.org JSON-LD rich snippets
on the frontend — no additional setup needed.

Internal Link Suggester
Scans your published posts and uses AI to find the 3 most natural and relevant internal
linking opportunities within the article you are writing.

Requirements

  • An OpenAI API key (or compatible endpoint)
  • WordPress 5.8+
  • PHP 7.4+

External Services

This plugin connects to the OpenAI API to provide AI-powered content analysis, FAQ generation,
and internal link suggestions.

What data is sent and when:
When you click “Analyze SEO”, “Generate FAQ” or “Suggest Internal Links” in the editor sidebar,
the text content of the post and the focus keyword are sent to the OpenAI API endpoint configured
in the plugin settings (default: https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions).

No data is sent automatically or without user action. No data is stored on any server
other than OpenAI’s in accordance with their data retention policies.

Service provider: OpenAI, L.L.C.
– Terms of use: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use
– Privacy policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
– API data usage policy: https://openai.com/policies/api-data-usage-policies

This plugin also supports custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints (e.g. Azure OpenAI Service).
In that case, the terms and privacy policy of that provider apply instead.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the rankifly-ai-content-optimizer folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP directly from the WordPress admin panel.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Rankifly AI to configure your API Key.
sections.faq:
Which AI models does it support?

The plugin supports standard OpenAI APIs (e.g. GPT-4.1-mini). You can configure a custom compatible endpoint directly in the settings.

Does OpenAI store my content?

OpenAI does not use data sent via API to train its models by default. See their API data usage policy for full details.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release. SEO Analysis, Readability, FAQ Generator and Internal Links supported.
  • Compatible with WordPress 6.9 and PHP 7.4+.
